mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the old temperature and door logs was most worthwhile: it made the spikes more understandable while clearly distinguishing air readings from the temperatures of stored objects.

leastWorthwhile.text: The attempted direct installation of the clean filter was a small confusing detour: it first needed to be combined with the fan, though the feedback resolved that automatically.

surprise.text: The repair produced a renewal warning on the supply controller even though the cabinet held its specified range.

arbitrary.text: No action felt entirely purposeless, although the required order of assembling the filter and fan before installation was not obvious to me.

continue.text: Yes. The practical repair and careful treatment of uncertain evidence were engaging, and I would be curious to see how the supply warning is handled.
